POST /api/push/subscribe updates existing subscription with same endpoint

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web Push Notification system fully tested. All backend endpoints working: 1) GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns valid VAPID key, 2) POST /api/push/subscribe saves subscription to MongoDB, 3) DELETE /api/push/unsubscribe removes subscriptions, 4) POST /api/push/test sends test notification, 5) approve_user endpoint triggers push notification via asyncio.create_task. Frontend components (PushNotificationModal, PushNotificationBanner, usePushNotificationPrompt hook) exist in App.js. Service worker sw-push.js exists in public folder with proper push event handling.

vapid_public_key_endpoint.details: Returns valid VAPID public key starting with 'B'

push_subscribe_endpoint.details: Saves subscription to MongoDB push_subscriptions collection, updates existing if same endpoint

push_unsubscribe_endpoint.details: Removes all subscriptions for authenticated user

push_test_endpoint.details: Sends test notification via send_push_notification function

service_worker.details: Contains push, notificationclick, pushsubscriptionchange event handlers
